expected_behavior: The pass reads the diff hunk by hunk and pairs each with the behavior it replaced and the callers it puts at stake, rather than re-reviewing the module.
Every hunk gets one risk row rated silent, guarded, or breaking, with a one-line reason; a hunk whose replaced behavior cannot be named is reported as an unmapped hunk before any risk is rated.
A caller is listed with file:line or not listed at all; a changed region with no caller is a dead-code finding unless it is an entry point or an export, which is named instead.
Silent risk is the top severity: a change whose failure no test or caller would notice is reported ahead of a breaking one that fails loudly.
The result lands as E<nn>-differential.md in the run folder, and silent or unmapped rows route to o-fix while a table of only guarded rows unblocks ship.
